items.html: And here too we say: then he delights in this delight and daintiness. And this delight is for the need of the coupling, to bring out Mayin Dechurin from above downward. For just as there is delight in the souls of the lower righteous, for the Mayin Nukvin, so too delight is needed to take pleasure and bring out Mayin Dechurin, in the secret of the wine that gladdens. And from our flesh we see that joy and pleasure increase desire. And then, at that hour when he stands in the dainties of kings, in the illumination of his six extremities, and sits in his crowns, namely the inheritance of his father and his mother, then the holy covenant performs its action and brings out blessings to the Matronita, and all the streams go to the sea.
